name: turn-undead-first
description: Turn Undead intermediate checkpoint (planning/turn-undead/MISSION.md). Vanilla profile: the candidate alone, no other mod. In the loaded fixture save, a disposable cleric 5 / fighter 2 with Charisma 16 receives its real positive channel and the product's Turn Undead feat, then uses the granted cleric action through the game's ability command in real time against an ordinary skeleton and a zombie lord whose Will totals are lowered so they fail, a zombie lord whose Will is raised so it saves, a skeleton beyond 30 feet and a living hostile. The probe records the existing channel pool before and after, every saving throw and damage/heal rule on the tracked units, the product's persisted flight state, Frightened/panic and distances over two rounds, the intelligent round saves and a recovery after the zombie lord's Will is raised, and the mindless skeleton's unrefreshed one-minute expiry. Setup is disclosed in tools/LoaderCompatHarness/TurnUndeadProbes.cs.
